{"description":"Read the whole output of a command whose result was cut in the middle, without running it again: the result of run, of the done-check or of read_process names it by an id such as out_1a2b. Give search to find the lines that hold a text, such as error or FAILED: the result lists each with its line number and its byte offset. Give offset to read from that byte, about 16 KB at a time; the result says where the next page starts. Reading runs nothing. Output is kept for a while after its command ended and only up to a quota: the result says when part of it was not saved, and an id that expired says so.","input_schema":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"case_insensitive":{"description":"Search ignoring case. Default false.","type":"boolean"},"id":{"description":"The id the result named.","type":"string"},"offset":{"description":"The byte to read from, or to search from. Default 0.","type":"integer"},"search":{"description":"Text to find, instead of reading: the lines that hold it, at most 40.","type":"string"},"wait_s":{"description":"For a process still running: seconds to wait for output past offset. Default 0, at most 30.","type":"integer"}},"required":["id"],"type":"object"},"name":"read_output","strict":true}
